statut: Regression ceilings for the local demo, checked by npm run measure:demo. They are never raised automatically: raising one is a reviewed change to this file. Deterministic demo scenario. Units: gzip (zlib level 9) of built files; decoded HTTP body bytes counted at the test browser transport over loopback, neither real compressed transfer nor a speed claim. entreeDeltaGzip: entry chunk growth over the witness build. bootstrapGzip: dynamic bootstrap chunk. panneauGzip: frame root chunk (toolbar, list, bubble, pins, correction, client, styles) plus its unique static imports not already loaded by entry or bootstrap. arriveeOuvertureOctets: total bytes from signed-in arrival to the open list, compared separately for the empty default, populated default and explicit editorial openings. ouvertureOctetsServis: bytes served by opening the list after arrival, same three openings. guideGzip and reperesOctetsServis: the guidance chunk in two units. captureGzip and captureOctetsServis: extra bytes between markers off and capture active, including the in-page replacement editor, without publishing images.
